pairs.title: Artesian Park, then Pineview Reservoir
pairs.note: Same area, not the exact same spot. About 1920, water bubbled up on its own from artesian wells near Huntsville, and families picnicked there. Ogden City drilled the wells in 1915. The dam was finished in 1937, and today the old park is under Pineview Reservoir.
pairs.credit: Then: Fred Pack, about 1920, J. Willard Marriott Library, University of Utah. Now: Tom Doxey.
